name: Retrieve cloud recording usage report
description: Retrieve cloud recording usage report Retrieve cloud recording usage report for a specified period. GET /v2/report/cloud_recording
context:
GET /v2/report/cloud_recording
Retrieve cloud recording usage report for a specified period. You can only get cloud recording reports for the most recent period of 6 months. The date gap between from and to dates should be smaller or equal to 30 days.
Required: from (query) — Start Date; to (query) — End Date

name: Retrieve daily report
description: Retrieve daily report Retrieve daily report for one month, can only get daily report for recent 6 months GET /v2/report/daily
context:
GET /v2/report/daily
Retrieve daily report for one month, can only get daily report for recent 6 months
Optional: year (query) — Year for this report; month (query) — Month for this report

description: Retrieve meeting details report Retrieve ended meeting details report GET /v2/report/meetings/{meetingId}

name: Retrieve meeting participants report
description: Retrieve meeting participants report Retrieve ended meeting participants report GET /v2/report/meetings/{meetingId}/participants
context:
GET /v2/report/meetings/{meetingId}/participants
Retrieve ended meeting participants report
Required: meetingId (path) — The meeting ID or meeting UUID. If given meeting ID, will take the last meeting instance.
Optional: page_size (query) — The number of records returned within a single API call; next_page_token (query) — Next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceed the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.
